title: Mildred Bailey and the Crosby brothers
summary: Mildred's story of her brother and Bing Crosby and the Whiteman band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I have always felt very close to them, always liked them, always happy to see them.
Mildred passed away a good thirty years ago. While she was here, it was always the same thing, it was always at the request of someone. She was a real artist, and Red is too.
Do you know Mildred's story of Bing Crosby?
Do you mean how she got on the Whitman Band?
Her brother was one of the Rhythm Boys.
Yes, but I think she got him the job and in turn he got her the job. It was pretty weird.
